mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription_redeem_code ( code_hash, plan_code, duration_days, status, expires_at, batch_name, created_by_user_id ) VALUES ( #{codeHash}, #{planCode}, #{durationDays}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{batchName}, #{createdByUserId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, code_hash, plan_code, duration_days, status, expires_at, batch_name, created_by_user_id, redeemed_by_user_id, redeemed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM subscription_redeem_code WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription_redeem_code SET status = 'redeemed', redeemed_by_user_id = #{redeemedByUserId}, redeemed_at = #{redeemedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'unused'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription_redeem_event ( redeem_code_id, user_id, plan_code, duration_days, before_plan_code, before_period_end, after_plan_code, after_period_end, redeem_ip, redeemed_at ) VALUES ( #{redeemCodeId}, #{userId}, #{planCode}, #{durationDays}, #{beforePlanCode}, #{beforePeriodEnd}, #{afterPlanCode}, #{afterPeriodEnd}, #{redeemIp}, #{redeemedAt} )
